audience: developers and operations teams who create PDF and Excel files from HTML with DocRaptor

useCases.title: Turn HTML or a web page URL into a PDF or Excel file
useCases.text: Creates a PDF, XLS or XLSX document from HTML you give or from a URL. By default it returns a download link, or the file as base64 if you ask.

useCases.title: Make a watermarked test document to check a layout
useCases.text: Creates a watermarked test document, so you can check how your HTML looks before you create real documents that use account credits.

useCases.title: Create a document as a background job and check it
useCases.text: Starts a document as an async job, then checks its status (queued, working, completed or failed). When done, you get the download link and the page count.

useCases.title: List the documents generated recently
useCases.text: Lists document metadata, newest first: name, type, test flag and creation time. DocRaptor does not keep the rendered files, so only this metadata is shown.

useCases.title: Get the IP addresses to allow on your firewall
useCases.text: Lists the IP addresses DocRaptor uses to fetch remote images and URLs, so you can allow them on a firewall or asset host.
